resources.string: ZCHAT uses Zcash shielded transactions to send encrypted messages directly on the blockchain. Your messages are encrypted with keys that only you and your recipient know — not us, not anyone else.
Unable to find a web browser app.
Shielded messages travel inside Zcash transactions. Open and Tunnel messages pass through Nostr relays, one of them run by ZChat. Relays can\'t read them, but can see which chat keys talk and when.
No phone number. No email. No account. Just download and start chatting. Your identity is your Zcash address — nothing more.

Messages are encrypted so only your contact can read them. Shielded messages are hidden inside Zcash shielded transactions, so network validators can\'t see their contents. Open and Tunnel messages are encrypted before they reach the relays that carry them.
The AI tab, and /ai in a chat, are optional. What you type there goes through ZChat\'s server to an outside AI service. Your other messages are not sent to it.
Built on the battle-tested Zcash protocol. Don\'t trust us — verify the code yourself.
ZCHAT: private messaging with no phone number, email or account.
New funds and Shielded messages use Zcash\'s Ironwood pool. ZCHAT makes no claim to resist future quantum computers.
No practical attack on today\'s Zcash shielded encryption is publicly known
Resisting quantum computers would need a future Zcash upgrade
Older ZEC in the sealed Orchard pool is still yours; the Old balance card on the Wallet tab shows how to move it to Ironwood, if it can be moved
